nodes.label: Trusted Platform Acquisition
nodes.rationale: The official Apple badge signals the recognized marketplace through which an iOS user can acquire the app.

nodes.label: Platform Distribution Call to Action
nodes.rationale: The branded badge gives users a recognizable action for acquiring the mobile app from Huawei's marketplace.

nodes.label: Cross-Device Handoff
nodes.rationale: A QR code in a desktop call to action lets a phone open the encoded mobile destination without manual URL entry.

nodes.label: Explore Destinations
nodes.rationale: The compass metaphor communicates orientation and exploration in a travel interface.

nodes.label: Atomic Database Generation
nodes.rationale: The generator writes a temporary database, verifies row count, route and day coverage, and SQLite integrity, then atomically replaces the output.

nodes.label: Search Result Eligibility
nodes.rationale: Sold-out fares are excluded and returned fares must have at least the requested number of seats.

nodes.label: Non-Production Visual Reference Use
nodes.rationale: The repository uses Omio-branded assets only as visual references for a non-production demo whose fare data is synthetic.

nodes.label: Graph-Guided Source Verification
nodes.rationale: Graph results narrow the files to inspect, while implementation and relevant tests remain authoritative when a graph is stale or incomplete.
